infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ParkingPal needs your location to find parking spots near you.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: ParkingPal needs your location to navigate you to parking spots.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ParkingPal needs camera access to take photos of your ID and parking spots.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ParkingPal needs photo library access to upload photos of parking spots.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow ParkingPal to use your location to find nearby parking spots.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow ParkingPal to access your camera to take photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow ParkingPal to access your photos to upload images.
